identity_screen: Quoted candidate/company/software/organization queries returned no substantiated exact active organization/software identity for the sixteen direct-available candidates. Ordinary descriptive uses, research phrases and marketing language were not treated as identity conflicts.
lightweight_public_trademark_signal: Quoted candidate + trademark queries returned no material candidate-specific mark signal for the sixteen. This is preliminary public-risk screening, not registry clearance.
selection_basis: Batch-level redundancy reduction only: replace repeated Each/Morrow/Other prefix-compound variants with materially different relational/concept phrase forms. This is not an Owner-quality ranking and does not assert the replacements are better names.
